<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>
  
  <!-- Status Bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="28" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px">9:41</text>
    <g transform="translate(305,14)">
      <circle cx="2" cy="11" r="1.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
      <circle cx="7" cy="9" r="1.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
      <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="1.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
      <circle cx="17" cy="5" r="1.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
      <line x1="26" y1="10" x2="31" y2="10" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="31" y1="10" x2="31" y2="5" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <rect x="37" y="6" width="22" height="10" rx="2.5" ry="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.1" opacity="0.85"/>
      <rect x="39" y="8" width="15" height="6" rx="1.2" ry="1.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
      <rect x="60" y="8.5" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="1" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="14" y="54" width="32" height="32" rx="16" fill="#26282C"/>
    <polyline points="34,64 26,70 34,76" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="34" y1="64" x2="26" y2="70" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="76" text-anchor="middle" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px">Comments</text>
    <g transform="translate(338,54)">
      <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="16" fill="#26282C"/>
      <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="2.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
      <circle cx="16" cy="10" r="2.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
      <circle cx="16" cy="22" r="2.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Post summary card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="100" width="354" height="138" rx="14" fill="#26282C"/>
    <rect x="20" y="102" width="354" height="138" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.14"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="124" r="16" fill="#5B6B7A"/>
    <text x="42" y="129" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600">J</text>
    <text x="66" y="121" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Jordan Miles</text>
    <text x="66" y="140" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">2h ago · Tech</text>
    <text x="22" y="170" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">SpaceX shares climb after booster</text>
    <text x="22" y="191" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Analysts point to strong launch cadence and</text>
    <text x="22" y="209" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">fresh commercial contracts driving momentum.</text>
    <rect x="300" y="114" width="58" height="24" rx="12" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="329" y="130" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600">Follow</text>
    <rect x="22" y="216" width="338" height="1" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Threaded comments -->
  <g>
    <!-- Comment 1 -->
    <g>
      <rect x="18" y="252" width="354" height="114" rx="14" fill="#26282C"/>
      <rect x="20" y="254" width="354" height="114" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
      <circle cx="42" cy="284" r="18" fill="#8A6D3B"/>
      <text x="42" y="289" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600">A</text>
      <text x="66" y="278" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Ava Chen</text>
      <text x="66" y="296" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400">12 min ago</text>
      <text x="66" y="320" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400">The timing makes sense if the next launch is on schedule.</text>
      <g transform="translate(246,314)">
        <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5.5" fill="#26282C" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="6" y1="3" x2="6" y2="9" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="9" y2="6" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <text x="16" y="10" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">Reply</text>
      </g>
      <g transform="translate(308,314)">
        <polygon points="8,0 10.1,5.5 16,5.5 11.2,9.1 13.1,14.7 8,11.4 2.9,14.7 4.8,9.1 0,5.5 5.9,5.5" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
        <text x="22" y="10" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">84</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Reply 1.1 -->
    <g>
      <line x1="42" y1="374" x2="42" y2="424" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="50" y="384" width="312" height="102" rx="14" fill="#222427"/>
      <circle cx="74" cy="412" r="15" fill="#4F6D8A"/>
      <text x="74" y="417" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600">M</text>
      <text x="96" y="406" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600">Mason Park</text>
      <text x="96" y="423" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400">8 min ago</text>
      <text x="96" y="446" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Worth noting the satellite imagery looked unusually clear.</text>
      <g transform="translate(262,438)">
        <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5.5" fill="#222427" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="6" y1="3" x2="6" y2="9" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="9" y2="6" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <text x="16" y="10" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">Reply</text>
      </g>
      <g transform="translate(298,438)">
        <polygon points="8,0 10.1,5.5 16,5.5 11.2,9.1 13.1,14.7 8,11.4 2.9,14.7 4.8,9.1 0,5.5 5.9,5.5" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
        <text x="22" y="10" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">19</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Comment 2 -->
    <g>
      <rect x="18" y="500" width="354" height="122" rx="14" fill="#26282C"/>
      <rect x="20" y="502" width="354" height="122" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
      <circle cx="42" cy="530" r="18" fill="#B56A5A"/>
      <text x="42" y="535" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600">K</text>
      <text x="66" y="524" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Kenji Watanabe</text>
      <text x="66" y="542" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400">27 min ago</text>
      <text x="66" y="566" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400">I’m more interested in the regulatory angle than the launch itself.</text>
      <text x="66" y="585" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400">Could affect guidance for next quarter.</text>
      <g transform="translate(246,564)">
        <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5.5" fill="#26282C" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="6" y1="3" x2="6" y2="9" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="9" y2="6" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <text x="16" y="10" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">Reply</text>
      </g>
      <g transform="translate(308,564)">
        <polygon points="8,0 10.1,5.5 16,5.5 11.2,9.1 13.1,14.7 8,11.4 2.9,14.7 4.8,9.1 0,5.5 5.9,5.5" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
        <text x="22" y="10" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">112</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Reply 2.1 -->
    <g>
      <line x1="42" y1="626" x2="42" y2="676" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="50" y="636" width="302" height="96" rx="14" fill="#222427"/>
      <circle cx="74" cy="664" r="15" fill="#6E7C4F"/>
      <text x="74" y="669" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600">S</text>
      <text x="96" y="658" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600">Sofia Alvarez</text>
      <text x="96" y="675" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400">21 min ago</text>
      <text x="96" y="698" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">True, but the market reaction has been unusually calm.</text>
      <g transform="translate(250,690)">
        <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5.5" fill="#222427" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="6" y1="3" x2="6" y2="9" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="9" y2="6" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <text x="16" y="10" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">Reply</text>
      </g>
      <g transform="translate(302,690)">
        <polygon points="8,0 10.1,5.5 16,5.5 11.2,9.1 13.1,14.7 8,11.4 2.9,14.7 4.8,9.1 0,5.5 5.9,5.5" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
        <text x="22" y="10" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">31</text>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- See more -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="748" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1877F2" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">See more</text>
    <line x1="112" y1="758" x2="172" y2="758" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.6"/>
    <line x1="218" y1="758" x2="278" y2="758" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#26282C"/>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="1" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <g transform="translate(24,780)">
      <polygon points="18,4 30,14 6,14" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
      <rect x="10" y="14" width="16" height="12" rx="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
      <text x="18" y="48" text-anchor="middle" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Explore -->
    <g transform="translate(104,780)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="18,10 20.5,18 18,26 15.5,18" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
      <text x="18" y="48" text-anchor="middle" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Bookmark -->
    <g transform="translate(184,780)">
      <rect x="10" y="6" width="16" height="22" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="10,28 18,22 26,28" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
      <text x="18" y="48" text-anchor="middle" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Comments active -->
    <g transform="translate(264,780)">
      <rect x="6" y="7" width="24" height="18" rx="5" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <polygon points="14,25 18,25 15,30" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="14" x2="24" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="18" x2="20" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="18" y="48" text-anchor="middle" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">Comments</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- subtle top/bottom overlays -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
</svg>
